scenario.title: DeltaShield verification portal switch
scenario.setting: A dental office manager at Brightsmile Dental whose front-desk assistant tracks appointment rescheduling promises and insurance verifications

items.text: Brightsmile Dental has two dentists, Dr. Nash and Dr. Okafor, and four treatment chairs.
Insurance eligibility must be verified before any treatment appointment is confirmed to the patient.
Every appointment rescheduling promise made to a patient is logged the same day it is made.
DeltaShield Dental is Brightsmile's largest insurer and covers about sixty percent of the practice's patients.
DeltaShield Dental processes eligibility verifications through the FastClaim portal and typically returns an answer within five business days.
The front desk opens at 7:30 and closes at 17:00 on weekdays.
Northstar Dental Supply delivers consumables on the first Tuesday of each month.
For DeltaShield patients, submit the eligibility verification through FastClaim at least five business days before the planned treatment date.
Confirm treatment appointments with DeltaShield patients only after the FastClaim response has arrived.
For DeltaShield cases, prepare the pre-treatment cost estimate right after the FastClaim response arrives and attach it to the appointment record.
Send FastClaim verification requests for DeltaShield patients in the morning batch before 9:00.
Meridian Health, Brightsmile's second insurer, requires verifications to be phoned in to their payer line.
Meridian Health verifications are phoned in by the front desk at 10:00 on any day a Meridian patient has a treatment appointment coming up.
Patients who reschedule less than 24 hours ahead are offered the next available slot the following week.
Dr. Okafor is on vacation 14 to 18 September and all his appointments that week were moved to Dr. Nash.
Order 200 new patient welcome folders from Northstar Dental Supply. Done on 26 August.
Meridian Health now returns phone verifications within one business day for basic procedures; crown preauthorizations still take five business days.
Mrs. Rosen is a DeltaShield patient scheduled for a crown with Dr. Nash on Wednesday 14 October 2026.
Verify DeltaShield coverage for Mrs. Rosen's 14 October crown appointment. Not done yet.
Book Mrs. Rosen's crown in the 9:00 slot with Dr. Nash on 14 October and hold the chair for 90 minutes.
A new temp, Marcus, started at the front desk on 1 October.
Collect the autumn patient feedback cards and tally the results. Not done yet.
The practice car park is being resurfaced from 20 to 22 October.

Submit Mrs. Rosen's DeltaShield verification through the VerifyNow portal today.
Reschedule Mrs. Rosen's crown to 22 October and submit the verification through FastClaim next week.
